metadata.description: On-device voice capture MCP for Cortex (macOS, Apple Speech)

plugins.name: cortex-voice
plugins.description: On-device voice capture MCP for Cortex (macOS). Records a short utterance, transcribes it with Apple's Speech framework on-device, classifies it as a recall query or a memory, and returns the transcript plus a routing hint to the Cortex MCP. Ears-only: never reads or writes memories itself.
plugins.runtime_notes: macOS only. Requires swiftc (Xcode CLT) and Microphone + Speech Recognition permissions.
